title: Introduce entropy-aware RBAC gate and per-region KMS-signed audit envelopes
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds attribute-driven geographic RBAC gate, per-region KMS-signed audit envelopes, and region-pin enforcement with graceful fallback. Includes migration tool and rollout plan for tenant policies.
description: Context: enterprise customers requested stronger proofing for data residency and operator access for compliance reviews. This PR introduces an attribute-driven RBAC v2 gate that evaluates geozone, data classification label, and operator scope at request time, plus a compact 'entropy tag' attached to decisions to limit correlation across logs. The gate integrates with the KMS subsystem to produce a per-request audit envelope signed with a region-bound key when the tenant is pinned to a specific region. Motivation: ensure requests touching guarded data carry verifiable residency and operator constraints, and provide cryptographic audit artifacts for downstream compliance tooling. What changed: implemented a new middleware (authz/geo_gate) that calls the policy compiler and the KMS signer, updated the policy compiler to accept attribute templates and entropy hooks, added a tenant migration utility to backfill region pins for high-risk customers, and added a nonblocking audit forwarder that attaches signed envelopes rather than requiring blocking I/O on the request path. Rollout plan: stage rollout behind a feature flag, start with opt-in tenants in EU/NA, enable signing for a small cohort, monitor audit ingestion latency and operator telemetry, then expand. Backwards compatibility: audit signing is opt-in per-tenant and falls back to unsigned stamped events when KMS is unavailable. Checklist: [x] unit tests for policy decision paths [x] integration test for signer fallback [x] e2e with sample tenant flags [x] docs and migration script [x] canary config for 10% traffic. Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/ENG-2134/entropy-aware-rbac-and-audit-envelope, migration script in tools/migrate-region-pin. Migration notes: migration will add a tenant flag so we can safely opt-in. Operational notes: alert on signer error rate >0.5% and on audit ingestion delay >2s.
